Within the `<head>` section, set the page title and, importantly, link to an external stylesheet named `styles.css`—we'll create that next.

Then, inside the ``, structure your profile content. Add an `

Follow that with an `<h2>` for 'Interests' and an unordered list, `<ul>`, containing at least three `<li>` items for your interests. Finally, add a `<footer>` with a copyright notice. Pay close attention to nesting and closing your tags correctly.
